params.description: Optional privacy carrier. The ART19 example leaves it empty; no destination applicability or consent-presence rule is inferred.

params.name: gdpr_consent
params.description: Optional consent carrier. Published blank and platform macro forms remain valid template boundaries; standard populated-value checks belong to core.

params.name: us_privacy
params.description: Optional carrier illustrated by PRX. Receiver semantics, applicability and current acceptance are not defined by that template.
